item.title: Strong jobs report sparks rate-hike fears, Citigroup delays rate-cut forecast to 2027
item.description: The U.S. economy added 162,000 jobs in August, more than triple the 53,000 economists had expected, pushing the unemployment rate to 4.1% and sparking fresh fears that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates later this month. item.title: US envoys arrive in Moscow to revive Ukraine peace push; limited ceasefire begins
item.description: Two of US President Donald Trump’s top envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, arrived in Moscow on Saturday to revive stalled efforts to end the war in Ukraine, as both sides agreed to a three-day limited ceasefire.
